'''House Vordarian''' is a minor House in [[Andor]]. Its only known member is [[Brandel Vordarian]], one of the [[Lord Captain]]<nowiki/>s of the [[Children of the Light]].

==Parallels==
The name is likely a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Vorkosigan Saga|Vorkosigan Saga]] in which the Vor- prefix indicates nobility. There is a [https://vorkosigan.fandom.com/wiki/Vordarian House Vordarian] in that series as well. The name is notably unusual for Andor.
